newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds on firm uptrend, traders say.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds on firm uptrend, traders say.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Austrian bonds marched higher on Wednesday and traders said the only way was up for the foreseeable future.
"Austria is unshakeable, firmer than Germany," said one trader.
Traders said there were hardly any sellers on the market. Demand and activity was shifting towards the long end, they noted.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 70 bps at 100.90 to yield 5.74 (5.84) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.63/73 to yield 5.78/77.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 up 35 bps at 104.10 to yield 4.46 (4.54) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 104.00/104.10 to yield 4.48/46 percent.
* AGB future up 14 bps at 108.09 on turnover of 70 lots.
* 10-year spread to German bunds down three at two bp, five-year spread down one at 13 bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.350 and overnight money steady at 3.13/3.38. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
